channel.title: The Orange County Register - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Orange County Register (ocregister.com)

item.title: Orange County scores and player stats for Friday, Feb. 20
item.description: Scores and stats from Orange County games on Friday, Feb. 20

item.title: Genesis Invitational: Adam Scott hunting a 3rd Riviera title after 2nd-round 63
item.description: The tournament’s all-time leading money winner, it’s no surprise to see the Australian tied for fourth at 9-under-par 133, three shots behind co-leaders Marco Penge and Jacob Bridgeman. Rory McIlroy is one shot off the lead.

item.title: Lakers’ Luke Kennard emphasizes communication in return to L.A.
item.description: Kennard, who has played in all four games since being acquired in a trade with Atlanta earlier this month, says the Lakers have made his return to the region a smooth transition.

item.title: Bianco gets piled on for saying something reasonable on immigration
item.description: It seems like any hint of reasonableness on immigration is verboten in the absolute circus that is the current GOP.

item.title: Luka Doncic’s 38-point night helps Lakers hold off Clippers
item.description: Doncic, Austin Reaves and LeBron James combine for 80 points and 24 assists in just their 11th game together this season, as the Lakers blow a 16-point lead in the second half before surviving, 125-122, to split the four-game season series.

item.title: Trabuco Hills boys basketball defeats Norte Vista to earn spot in D4 final
item.description: Ryan Hull leads the way for Trabuco Hills with 37 points, but his teammates also come through with some big plays in crucial moments.

item.title: JSerra boys basketball tops Inglewood, advances to Division 1 title game
item.description: JSerra beats Inglewood in a high-scoring semifinal in the CIF-SS Division 1 playoffs. The Lions will face Crean Lutheran in the championship game.

item.title: ‘Special’ season for Corona del Mar boys basketball ends at St. John Bosco
item.description: Maxwell Scott scores 17 points as the Sea Kings lose in a CIF-SS Open Division play-in game for a spot in the SoCal regional.

item.title: Garrett Pickens’ bank shot lifts Ramona boys basketball team past Placentia Valencia
item.description: Pickens banked in a 3-pointer with 0.9 seconds left on the clock to send the Rams to the section finals for the second straight season.

item.title: Aliso Niguel boys basketball earns spot in CIF-SS finals with win over Gahr
item.description: Aliso Niguel relies on its interior play to beat Gahr in the semifinals, and now it has a chance to win the school's first CIF-SS title since 2005.
